paite: Hiai thilte zoh in angel li, lei kil li a dinghte'n leitung a huih lite leitung a nung lou ding leh tuipi tung hiam, ahihkeileh sing tung hiam a nung lou ding in akhawlsak uhi.
heading: Israel Mi Nuaikhat Singli-le-sangli Chiamtehna
english: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

paite: Huan amau chiamtehna a pan angel dang kuantou ka mu hi, Pathian hing chiamtehna anei ua; ama'n huai angel lite leitung leh tuipi hihse ding a piak a omte kiang ah aw ngaihtak a kikou in.
english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

paite: "Pathian sikhate atal ua i chiamteh zoh ma in leitung leh tuipi leh singte hihse kei un," achi hi.
english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

paite: Huai chiamteh a omte lak a tampi, nuaikhat singli-le-sangli, Israel suan chiteng a kipan chiamteh zah ka za hi.
english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

paite: Judah chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih chiamteh in a-om ua. Reuben chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Gad chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih;
english: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

paite: Asher chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Naphtali chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Manasseh chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih;
english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

paite: Simeon chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Levi chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Issakar chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih;
english: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

paite: Zebulun chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih, Joseph chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih, Benjamin chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih.
english: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

paite: Hiai thil teng zoh in ka etleh ngai in, mipi tampi kuamah sim seng louh, nam chih leh chi chih leh mi tengteng leh pau tengteng a kipan laltutphah leh Belamnou ma a dingh a, puanngou thupi a kizem a tumnah tawi ka mu a,
heading: Mipi Tampi Muhna
english: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

paite: huan amau aw ngaihtak in, "Laltutphah a tu i Pathian leh Belamnou kiang ah hotdamna," chi in akikou uhi.
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

paite: Angel tengteng laltutphah leh upate leh thil hing lite kimvel in adingh ua; laltutphah ma a bokkhup in, Pathian abia uhi:
english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

paite: "Amen! Vualzawlnate, leh thupinate, leh pilnate, leh zahtakhuainate, leh thilhihtheihnate, leh hatnate, tangtawn tangtawn in i Pathian kiang ah om hen,” achi uhi.
english: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

paite: Huan upate lak a khat in ka kiang ah, "Hiai puanngou thupi a kizemte kuate ahi ua, koi a kipan a hong pai ahi ua?” chi in ahon houpih a,
english: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

paite: ke'n akiang ah, "Ka Toupa, nang na thei hi," ka chi hi. Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai mite gimthuakna thupi a kipan hong paite ahi ua, apuan thupi uh sawp in, Belamnou sisan in ahihngou uhi."
english: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

paite: "Huaiziak in Pathian laltutphah ma ah a-om ua, sun leh zan in atempul uah amah asepsak uhi; amah laltutphah tung a tupa'n amau tung ah apuanin azak ding hi.
english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

paite: Agil uh kial nawn ke'n chin, adang uh tak nawn himhim ke'n teh, amau ni in kang ke'n chin, satna in leng ahihgim kei ding hi.
english: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

paite: Belamnou huai laltutphah lak a om abelamchingpa uh ahih ding ziak in, amau hinna tuikhuk ah api ding a; Pathian in amit ua kipan khitui anulhul ding," achi hi.
english: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”
